content: Indirect prompt injection from fetched web content is NOT fully solvable: LLMs cannot reliably separate data-to-summarize from instructions-to-follow; anything in the context window can influence behavior. Defense-in-depth only. Markdown-image/link rendering exfiltrates context-window data with zero user click (Bing Chat, ChatGPT, Claude, etc all hit). Combined defenses (content filtering+anomaly detection+guardrails+verification) cut attack success ~73%->~9% but never to zero. Least-privilege tool access (read/summarize only, no exfil tool) is the strongest lever.
